newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes slightly down but off lows.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes slightly down but off lows.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed off the lows but still down on the day having recovered some ground from a fall triggered by losses on NYMEX crude and products.
Feb gas oil closed 25 cents down at $213.50 a tonne, off a low of $211.50. Earlier the contract had climbed to a session high of $216.75.
The early gains were attributed to better than expected API stock data, but milder weather in Europe dampened its effects.
Traders said that heavy selling by investment funds prompted the sharp afternoon drop.
"The funds are in there and selling heavily," said a broker.
Feb Brent was trading 17 cents down at $23.19 a barrel at 1753 GMT, off a low of $23.08 a barrel.
"It came off quite heavy but the spreads are holding up and I think we might see some retracement by the end of the night," said a broker.
The Feb Brent/gas oil crack spread was trading at $5.43 a barrel at 1756.
